mapper.select: SELECT r.REPAIR_NO, r.RECEIPT_CODE, r.RECEIPT_TITLE, r.MODEL_NAME, r.RECEIPT_ADDRESS, r.RECEIPT_STATUS, r.RECEIPT_URGENT, r.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_ITEM, u.USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(r.RECEIPT_VISIT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS VISIT_AT_TEXT, TO_CHAR(r.RECEIPT_CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT_TEXT, (SELECT MAX(e.ESTIMATES_ID) FROM ESTIMATES e WHERE e.REPAIR_NO = r.REPAIR_NO AND e.FIXER_ID = #{fixerId}) AS MY_ESTIMATE_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPAIR_PHOTO p WHERE p.REPAIR_NO = r.REPAIR_NO) AS PHOTO_COUNT FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS r JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = r.CATEGORY_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID WHERE ORDER BY r.RECEIPT_URGENT DESC, r.RECEIPT_CREATED_AT DESC
